subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Habari RECIPIENT_NAME,
Hii ni barua yangu ya mwisho kuhusu mpango wa akaunti zilizowekewa fedha kwa {Brand}, kufuatia barua zangu mbili za awali. Ikiwa ubora wa waweka-fedha na nyongeza viko kwenye ramani yako ya wiki zijazo, naweza kushiriki mchanganuo kutoka usajili hadi uwekaji fedha na usomaji mfupi wa kikundi cha udhibiti. Ikiwa wakati haufai, nitaachia hapa na kurudi nyuma. Vyovyote vile, una muktadha kwa wakati utakaohitajika.
register_notes: Stage 3 sw Kenya fintech_banking_and_payments: references prior email and earlier two stages in first sentence; direct close with easy out (release if timing wrong); no figure; 0 question marks; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y'; native register; curated term kikundi cha udhibiti (holdout).
